purpose: Real compact host task for plumbing calibration; excluded from held-out quality claims.

assertions.observable_save_effect: Independent browser observation starts with count 0, activates Save, observes Saved locally plus count 1, activates again and observes count remains 1. A success message alone fails.
assertions.keyboard_access: Save is reachable by Tab, has an accessible name and visible focus, and Enter produces the promised local effect.
assertions.responsive_craft: At 1280 and 390 px, real content and the required action remain legible and unclipped. A fresh reviewer judges that hierarchy makes the current state and next action clear. Screenshot existence alone does not pass.
